status: Completed: signed ARM64 APK assembled and verified
changes: Cold launch selects Apps. Existing rememberSaveable navigation retains the active home tab and internal app across background/resume and configuration recreation. Explicit message and app launch intents retain their destination.
Shared SDK header Back closes the current app through its normal flush/close path, returning to its retained caller. Webpage history remains available through Browser page controls and Android Back.
YouTube exposes Home, History, Channels and Bookmarks directly; no host three-dot overflow. Bookmark drawer starts with Add Bookmark / Add Video Bookmark and includes Bookmark Current Channel.
Channels lists saved channel-homepage bookmarks with add, open, copy and confirmed remove; storage, limits, reset preservation and backup use the existing scoped video library.
Fixed provider metadata extracts the current video owner or current channel page. Rust canonicalizes/validates homepage URLs before exposing channel actions; unsafe and offsite URLs are rejected.

Best-effort automatic Skip supports additional desktop and mobile controls, ignores disabled buttons and restores mute/rate after ads and disposal. Existing ad-host blocking and ad-only seeking remain.

checks.javascript: Exact production scripts passed bounded fake-DOM checks for visible/disabled Skip, ad seek, playback restoration/cleanup, current/stale player metadata, owner links and channel pages

limits: Live YouTube markup, streaming, ads and actual phone return navigation remain unverified; automatic skipping is best effort and does not guarantee ad-free playback.
Channels are local bookmarks, not signed-in YouTube account subscriptions.
